sn42.13:1.1: ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā koliyesu viharati uttarakaṃ nāma koliyānaṃ nigamo.
sn42.13:1.2: atha kho pāṭaliyo gāmaṇi yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami. upasaṅkamitvā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi. ekamantaṃ nisinno kho pāṭaliyo gāmaṇi bhagavantaṃ etadavoca:
sn42.13:2.1: ye te bhante evamāhaṃsu: “samaṇo gotame māyaṃ jānātī”ti, kacci te bhante bhagavato vuttavādino, na ca bhagavantaṃ abhūtena abbhācikkhanti, dhammassa cānudhammaṃ vyākaronti, na ca koci sahadhammiko vādānupāto gārayhaṃ ṭhānaṃ āgacchati,
sn42.13:2.3: ye te gāmaṇi evamāhaṃsu: “samaṇo gotamo māyaṃ jānātī”ti, vuttavādino ceva me te, na ca maṃ abhūtena abbhācikkhanti, dhammassa cānudhammaṃ vyākaronti, naca koci sahadhammiko vādānupāto gārayhaṃ ṭhānaṃ āgacchatīti,
sn42.13:2.4: saccaṃ yeva kira bho mayaṃ tesaṃ samaṇabrāhmaṇānaṃ na saddahāma:
sn42.13:2.5: samaṇo gotamo māyaṃ jānātīti, samaṇo khalu bho gotamo māyāvīti.
sn42.13:2.6: yonu kho gāmaṇi evaṃ vadeti; “ahaṃ māyaṃ jānāmī”ti, so evaṃ vadeti, “ahaṃ māyāvī”ti.
sn42.13:2.7: tatheva taṃ bhagavā hoti, tatheva taṃ sugata hotīti.
sn42.13:2.8: tena hi gāmaṇi, taññevettha paṭipucchissāmi, yathā te khameyya tathā naṃ vyākareyyāsi. taṃ kimmaññasi
sn42.13:3.2: jānāsi tvaṃ gāmaṇi, koliyānaṃ lambacūḷake bhaṭeti.
sn42.13:3.4: taṃ kimmaññasi gāmaṇi kimatthiyā koliyānaṃ lambacūḷakā bhaṭāti.
sn42.13:3.5: ye ca bhante koliyānaṃ corā te ca paṭisedhetuṃ, yāni ca koliyānaṃ dūteyyāni tāni vahātuṃ, etadatthāya bhante koliyānaṃ lambacūḷakā bhaṭāti.
sn42.13:3.7: jānāsi tvaṃ koliyānaṃ lambacūḷake bhaṭe sīlavante vā te dussīle vāti.
sn42.13:3.8: jānāmahaṃ bhante koliyānaṃ lambacūḷake bhaṭe dussīle pāpadhamme, ye ca loke dussīlā pāpadhammā koliyānaṃ lambacūḷakā bhaṭā tesaṃ aññatarāti.
sn42.13:3.9: yo nu kho gāmaṇi evaṃ vadeyya:
sn42.13:3.10: “pāṭaliyo gāmaṇi jānāti koliyānaṃ lambacūḷake bhaṭe dussīle pāpadhamme, pāṭaliyopi gāmaṇi dussīlo pāpadhammo”ti, sammā nu kho so vadamāno vadeyyāti.
sn42.13:3.12: aññe bhante koliyānaṃ lambacūḷakā bhaṭā, añño’hamasmi. aññathādhammā koliyānaṃ lambacūḷakā bhaṭā, aññathādhammo’hamasmīti.
sn42.13:3.13: tvaṃ hi gāmaṇi lacchasi “pāṭaliyo gāmaṇi jānāti koliyānaṃ lambacūḷake bhaṭe dussīle pāpadhamme, na ca pāṭaliyo gāmaṇi dussīlo pāpadhammo”ti, kasmā tathāgato na lacchati “tathāgato māyaṃ jānāti, na ca tathāgato māyāvī”ti.
sn42.13:3.14: māyaṃ cāhaṃ gāmaṇi pajānāmi māyāya ca vipākaṃ, yathā paṭipanno ca māyāvī kāyassa bhedā parammaraṇā apāyaṃ duggatiṃ vinipātaṃ nirayaṃ upapajjati, tañca pajānāmi.
sn42.13:4.1: pāṇātipātaṃ cāhaṃ gāmaṇi pajānāmi pāṇātipātassa ca vipākaṃ, yathā paṭipanno ca pāṇātipātī kāyassa bhedā parammaraṇā apāyaṃ duggatiṃ vinipātaṃ nirayaṃ upapajjati, tañca pajānāmi.
sn42.13:4.2: adinnādānaṃ cāhaṃ gāmaṇi pajānāmi adinnādānassa ca vipākaṃ, yathāpaṭipanno ca adinnādāyī kāyassa bhedā parammaraṇā apāyaṃ duggatiṃ vinipātaṃ nirayaṃ upapajjati, tañca pajānāmi.
sn42.13:4.3: kāmesu micchācāraṃ cāhaṃ gāmaṇi pajānāmi, kāmesu micchācārassa ca vipākaṃ, yathāpaṭipanno ca kāmesu micchācārī kāyassa bhedā parammaraṇā apāyaṃ duggatiṃ vinipātaṃ nirayaṃ upapajjati, tañca pajānāmi.
sn42.13:4.4: musāvādaṃ cāhaṃ gāmaṇi pajānāmi musāvādassa ca vipākaṃ, yathā paṭipanno ca musāvādī kāyassa bhedā parammaraṇā apāyaṃ duggatiṃ vinipātaṃ nirayaṃ upapajjati tañca pajānāmi.
sn42.13:4.5: pisunāvācaṃ cāhaṃ gāmaṇi pajānāmi pisunāvācāya ca vipākaṃ, yathāpaṭipanno ca pisunāvāco kāyassa bhedā parammaraṇā apāyaṃ duggatiṃ vinipātaṃ nirayaṃ upapajjati, tañca pajānāmi.
sn42.13:4.6: pharusavācaṃ cāhaṃ gāmaṇi pajānāmi pharusavācāya ca vipākaṃ, yathāpaṭipanno ca pharusavāco kāyassa bhedā parammaraṇā apāyaṃ duggatiṃ vinipātaṃ nirayaṃ upapajjati, tañca pajānāmi.
sn42.13:4.7: samphappalāpaṃ cāhaṃ gāmaṇi pajānāmi samphappalāpassa ca vipākaṃ, yathāpaṭipanno ca samphappalāpī kāyassa bhedā parammaraṇā apāyaṃ duggatiṃ vinipātaṃ nirayaṃ upapajjati tañca pajānāmi.
sn42.13:4.8: abhijjhaṃ cāhaṃ gāmaṇi pajānāmi abhijjhāya ca vipākaṃ, yathāpaṭipanno ca abhijjhālu kāyassa bhedā parammaraṇā apāyaṃ duggatiṃ vinipātaṃ nirayaṃ upapajjati, tañca pajānāmi.
sn42.13:4.9: vyāpādapadosañcāhaṃ gāmaṇi pajānāmi vyāpādapadosassa ca vipākaṃ, yathāpaṭipanno ca vyāpannacitto kāyassa bhedā parammaraṇā apāyaṃ duggatiṃ vinipātaṃ nirayaṃ upapajjati tañca pajānāmi.
sn42.13:4.10: micchādiṭṭhiñcāhaṃ gāmaṇi pajānāmi micchādiṭṭhiyā ca vipākaṃ, yathāpaṭipanno ca micchādiṭṭhiko kāyassa bhedā parammaraṇā apāyaṃ duggatiṃ vinipātaṃ nirayaṃ upapajjati, tañca pajānāmi.
sn42.13:5.1: santi hi gāmaṇi eke samaṇabrāhmaṇā evaṃvādino evaṃdiṭṭhino:
sn42.13:5.2: yo koci pāṇamatipāteti, sabbo so diṭṭheva dhamme dukkhaṃ domanassaṃ paṭisaṃvediyati.
sn42.13:5.3: yo koci adinnaṃ ādiyati, sabbo so diṭṭheva dhamme dukkhaṃ domanassaṃ paṭisaṃvediyati.
sn42.13:5.4: yo koci kāmesu micchā carati sabbo so diṭṭheva dhamme dukkhaṃ domanassaṃ paṭisaṃvediyati.
sn42.13:5.5: yo koci musā bhaṇati, sabbo so diṭṭheva dhamme dukkhaṃ domanassaṃ paṭisaṃvediyatīti.
sn42.13:6.1: dissati kho pana gāmaṇi idhekacco mālī kuṇḍalī sunahāto suvilitto kappitakesamassu itthikāmehi rājā maññe paricārento.
sn42.13:6.3: ambho ayaṃ puriso kiṃ akāsi mālī kuṇḍalī sunahāto suvilitto kappitakesamassu itthikāmehi rājā maññe paricāretīti?
sn42.13:6.5: ambho ayaṃ puriso rañño paccatthikaṃ pasayha jīvitā voropesi
sn42.13:6.7: tenāyaṃ puriso mālī kuṇḍalī sunahāto suvilitto kappitakesamassu itthikāmehi rājā maññe paricāretīti.
sn42.13:7.1: dissati kho pana gāmaṇi idhekacco daḷhāya rajjuyā pacchābāhaṃ gāḷhabandhanaṃ bandhitvā khuramuṇḍaṃ karitvā kharassarena paṇavena rathikāya rathikaṃ siṅghāṭakena siṅghāṭakaṃ parinetvā dakkhiṇena dvārena nikkhāmetvā dakkhiṇato nagarassa sīsaṃ chijjamāno.
sn42.13:7.3: ambho ayaṃ puriso kiṃ akāsi daḷhāya rajjuyā pacchābāhaṃ gāḷhabandhanaṃ bandhitvā khuramuṇḍaṃ karitvā kharassarena paṇavena rathikāya rathikaṃ siṅghāṭakena siṅghāṭakaṃ parinetvā dakkhiṇena dvārena nikkhāmetvā dakkhiṇato nagarassa sīsaṃ chindatīti.
sn42.13:7.5: ambho, ayaṃ puriso rājaverī itthiṃ vā purisaṃ vā jīvitā voropesi,
sn42.13:7.6: tena naṃ rājāno gahetvā evarūpaṃ kammakāraṇaṃ kārentīti.
sn42.13:8.2: api nu te evarūpaṃ diṭṭhaṃ vā sutaṃvāti.
sn42.13:8.3: diṭṭhañca no bhante sutañca sūyissati cāti.
sn42.13:8.4: tatra gāmaṇi ye te samaṇabrāhmaṇā evaṃvādino evaṃdiṭṭhino:
sn42.13:8.5: “yo koci pāṇamatipāteti, sabbo so diṭṭheva dhamme dukkhaṃ domanassaṃ paṭisaṃvediyatī”ti, saccaṃ vā te āhaṃsu musā vāti.
sn42.13:8.7: ye pana te tucchaṃ musā vilapanti, sīlavanto vā te dussīlā vāti.
sn42.13:8.9: ye pana te dussīlā pāpadhammā micchāpaṭipannā vā te sammāpaṭipannā vāti.
sn42.13:8.11: ye pana te micchāpaṭipannā micchādiṭṭhikā vā te sammādiṭṭhikā vāti.
sn42.13:8.13: ye pana te micchādiṭṭhikā kallannu tesu pasīditunti.

sn42.13:14.5: ambho ayaṃ puriso gahapatissa vā gahapatiputtassa vā musāvādena atthaṃ bhañji,
sn42.13:14.6: tena taṃ rājāno gahetvā evarūpaṃ kammakāraṇaṃ kārentīti.

sn42.13:15.3: tattha mañcakāni atthi, āsanāni atthi, udakamaṇiko atthi, telappadīpo atthi,
sn42.13:15.4: tattha yo samaṇo vā brāhmaṇo vā vāsaṃ upeti, tenāhaṃ yathāsatti yathābalaṃ saṃvibhajāmi.
sn42.13:15.5: bhūtapubbaṃ bhante, cattāro satthāro nānādiṭṭhikā nānākhantikā nānārucikā tasmiṃ āvasathāgāre vāsaṃ upagacchiṃsu.
sn42.13:16.2: natthi dinnaṃ, natthi yiṭṭhaṃ, natthi hutaṃ, natthi sukaṭadukkaṭānaṃ kammānaṃ phalaṃ vipāko. natthi ayaṃ loko, natthi paro loko, natthi mātā, natthi pitā, natthi sattā opapātikā, natthi loke samaṇabrāhmaṇā sammaggatā sammāpaṭipannā ye imañca lokaṃ parañca lokaṃ sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā pavedentīti.
sn42.13:17.2: atthi dinnaṃ, atthi yiṭṭhaṃ, atthi hutaṃ, atthi sukaṭadukkaṭānaṃ kammānaṃ phalaṃ vipāko, atthi ayaṃ loko, atthi paro loko, atthi mātā, atthi pitā, atthi sattā opapātikā, atthi loke samaṇabrāhmaṇā sammaggatā sammāpaṭipannā, ye imañca lokaṃ parañca lokaṃ sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā pavedentīti.
sn42.13:18.2: karato kārayato chindato chedāpayato pacato pācayato socayato kilamayato phandato phandāpayato pāṇamatipātayato adinnaṃ ādiyato sandhiṃ chindato nillopaṃ harato ekāgārikaṃ karoto paripanthe tiṭṭhato paradāraṃ gacchato musā bhaṇato karoto na karīyati pāpaṃ.
sn42.13:18.3: khurapariyantena cepi cakkena yo imissā paṭhaviyā pāṇe ekamaṃsakhalaṃ ekamaṃsapuñjaṃ kareyya, natthi tatonidānaṃ pāpaṃ, natthi pāpassa āgamo.
sn42.13:18.4: dakkhiṇañcepi gaṅgāya tīraṃ gaccheyya hananto ghātento chindanto chedāpento pacanto pācento natthi tatonidānaṃ pāpaṃ, natthi pāpassa āgamo.
sn42.13:18.5: uttarañcepi gaṅgāya tīraṃ gaccheyya dadanto dāpento yajanto yājento natthi tatonidānaṃ puññaṃ, natthi puññassa āgamo.
sn42.13:18.6: dānena damena saññamena saccavajjena natthi puññaṃ natthi puññassa āgamoti.

sn42.13:19.3: khurapariyantenapi cakkena yo imissā paṭhaviyā pāṇe ekamaṃsakhalaṃ ekamaṃsapuñjaṃ kareyya, atthi tatonidānaṃ pāpaṃ, atthi pāpassa āgamo.
sn42.13:19.4: dakkhiṇañcepi gaṅgāya tīraṃ gaccheyya hananto ghātento chindanto chedāpento pacanto pācento atthi tatonidānaṃ pāpaṃ, atthi pāpassa āgamo.
sn42.13:19.5: uttarañcepi gaṅgāya tīraṃ gaccheyya dadanto dāpento yajanto yājento atthi tatonidānaṃ puññaṃ, atthi puññassa āgamo.
sn42.13:19.6: dānena damena saññamena saccavajjena atthi puññaṃ atthi puññassa āgamoti.
sn42.13:20.1: tassa mayhaṃ bhante ahudeva kaṅkhā ahudeva vicikicchā:
sn42.13:20.2: ko su nāma imesaṃ bhavataṃ samaṇabrāhmaṇānaṃ saccaṃ āha, ko musāti.
sn42.13:21.1: alaṃ hi te gāmaṇi, kaṅkhituṃ, alaṃ vicikicchituṃ.
sn42.13:21.2: kaṅkhanīye ca pana te ṭhāne vicikicchā uppannāti.
sn42.13:21.3: evaṃ pasannohaṃ bhante bhagavati. pahoti me bhagavā tathā dhammaṃ desetuṃ yathāhaṃ imaṃ kaṅkhādhammaṃ pajaheyyanti.
sn42.13:22.2: tatra ce tvaṃ cittasamādhiṃ paṭilabheyyāsi. evaṃ tvaṃ imaṃ kaṅkhādhammaṃ pajaheyyāsi.
sn42.13:22.4: idha gāmaṇi, ariyasāvako pāṇātipātaṃ pahāya pāṇātipātā paṭivirato hoti, nihitadaṇḍo nihitasattho lajjī dayāpanno sabbapāṇabhūtahitānukampī viharati. adinnādānaṃ pahāya adinnādānā paṭivirato hoti, kāmesu micchācāraṃ pahāya kāmesu micchācārā paṭivirato hoti, musāvādaṃ pahāya musāvādā paṭivirato hoti, pisunaṃ vācaṃ pahāya pisunāya vācāya paṭivirato hoti, pharusaṃ vācaṃ pahāya pharusāya vācāya paṭivirato hoti, samphappalāpaṃ pahāya samphappalāpā paṭivirato hoti, abhijjhaṃ pahāya anabhijjhālū hoti, vyāpādapadosaṃ pahāya avyāpannacitto hoti, micchādiṭṭhiṃ pahāya sammādiṭṭhiko hoti.

sn42.13:23.4: “natthi dinnaṃ, natthi yiṭṭhaṃ, natthi hutaṃ, natthi sukaṭadukkaṭānaṃ kammānaṃ phalaṃ vipāko, natthi ayaṃ loko, natthi paro loko, natthi mātā, natthi pitā, natthi sattā opapātikā, natthi loke samaṇabrāhmaṇā sammaggatā sammāpaṭipannā ye imañca lokaṃ parañca lokaṃ sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā pavedentī”ti.

sn42.13:23.6: ubhayamettha kaṭaggāho: yañcamhi kāyena saṃvuto vācāya saṃvuto manasā saṃvuto, yañca kāyassa bhedā parammaraṇā sugatiṃ saggaṃ lokaṃ upapajjissāmīti.
